svg.title: odysseusai
svg.desc: Container images. Independent images of the Odysseus AI workspace, built from upstream and booted with the full stack before they're tagged. Built from: Upstream Odysseus, rebuilt nightly. Ships as: GHCR images and Compose files. Install: git clone https://github.com/netspeedy/odysseusai.git, then cd odysseusai && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d.
svg.text: Independent images of the Odysseus AI workspace, built from
upstream and booted with the full stack before they're tagged.
